raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

For text-only chat requests on multimodal models, the Jinja path decodes and caches the full prompt even when the engine can use token IDs. Long agent histories miss that cache and repeat the decode work.

## Modifications

Keep prompt IDs for text-only requests and decode only when a caller needs text. Requests with media retain the decoded prompt and cache path, as do Responses, Moss-VL, and special-token fallbacks. Engine input stays the same. This can merge independently from the prompt-segment cache in #42187.

## Accuracy Tests

Focused chat conversion regressions and scoped formatting pass on the updated branch. Earlier checks with the real GLM-5.3-Flash tokenizer matched chat IDs, Responses text and image prompts against the comparison base. GPU serving on this branch remains unverified.

Run the unit suites with `python -m pytest` and formatting with `pre-commit run --files <changed-files>`.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

A local CPU benchmark on the previous PR revision used the real GLM tokenizer with text-only prompts of about 112K to 120K tokens. Median conversion time was 20.7 to 22.3 ms there, compared with 36.5 to 49.2 ms on the comparison base; the decoded-prompt cache retained 4.25 MB per turn on that base and 0 MB on the previous PR revision. Decoding the final prompt alone took 15 to 18 ms.


## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

files.patch:
@@ -2311,7 +2311,8 @@ class RequestResponseMetadata(BaseModel):
 
 @dataclass
 class MessageProcessingResult:
-    prompt: str
+    # None: a text-only prompt on a multimodal model that was not decoded yet.
+    prompt: Optional[str]
     prompt_ids: Union[str, List[int]]
     image_data: Optional[Any]
     audio_data: Optional[Any]

@@ -1169,7 +1169,13 @@ def _engine_prompt(
             and not chat_encoding.spec_renders_prompt_ids(self.chat_encoding_spec)
             and not prefers_prompt_ids
         ):
-            return "text", processed_messages.prompt
+            prompt = processed_messages.prompt
+            if prompt is None:
+                # A text-only request that is sent as text is decoded only here.
+                prompt = self.tokenizer_manager.tokenizer.decode(
+                    processed_messages.prompt_ids
+                )
+            return "text", prompt
         if isinstance(processed_messages.prompt_ids, str):
             return "text", processed_messages.prompt_ids
         return "input_ids", processed_messages.prompt_ids
@@ -1738,13 +1744,17 @@ def _apply_jinja_template(
                 if self._tokenizer_auto_adds_specials
                 else {}
             )
+            # Only a request with media needs the prompt text and its cache: the
+            # MM processor reads the text. A text-only request is decoded later,
+            # and only if it is not sent as ids.
+            has_media = bool(image_data or video_data or audio_data or modalities)
             try:
                 prompt_ids, decoded_prompt = self._render_and_encode_chat_template(
                     openai_compatible_messages,
                     tools=tools,
                     template_kwargs=extra_template_kwargs,
                     encode_kwargs=encode_kwargs,
-                    use_cache=is_multimodal,
+                    use_cache=is_multimodal and has_media,
                 )
             except Exception:
                 # If the first attempt fails, try with flat function-only format.
@@ -1760,7 +1770,7 @@ def _apply_jinja_template(
                         tools=tools,
                         template_kwargs=extra_template_kwargs,
                         encode_kwargs=encode_kwargs,
-                        use_cache=is_multimodal,
+                        use_cache=is_multimodal and has_media,
                     )
                 except _CHAT_TEMPLATE_CLIENT_ERRORS as template_error:
                     # Template errors (e.g., from raise_exception in Jinja templates)
@@ -1776,12 +1786,14 @@ def _apply_jinja_template(
                 # The cached decode corresponds to prompt_ids before the prefix.
                 decoded_prompt = None
 
-            if is_multimodal:
+            if is_multimodal and has_media:
                 prompt = (
                     decoded_prompt
                     if decoded_prompt is not None
                     else self.tokenizer_manager.tokenizer.decode(prompt_ids)
                 )
+            elif is_multimodal:
+                prompt = None
 
         stop = request.stop
         image_data = image_data if image_data else None

@@ -642,6 +642,28 @@ def test_text_only_prompt_reuses_rendered_token_ids(self):
         self.assertEqual(adapted.input_ids, [11, 22, 33])
         self.assertIsNone(adapted.text)
 
+    def test_text_only_prompt_is_not_decoded_into_the_template_cache(self):
+        self.tm.model_config.is_multimodal = True
+        self.chat.chat_encoding_spec = None
+        self.template_manager.chat_template_name = None
+        self.template_manager.jinja_template_content_format = "string"
+        self.chat._tokenizer_auto_adds_specials = False
+        self.chat._prompt_text_round_trip_is_lossy = False
+        tokenizer = self.tm.tokenizer
+        tokenizer.apply_chat_template.side_effect = lambda messages, **_: "".join(
+            m["content"] for m in messages
+        )
+        tokenizer.encode.side_effect = lambda text, **_: [ord(c) for c in text]
+        tokenizer.decode.side_effect = lambda ids, **_: "".join(map(chr, ids))
+
+        adapted, _ = self.chat._convert_to_internal_request(self.basic_req)
+        self.assertEqual(adapted.input_ids, [ord(c) for c in "Hi?"])
+        self.assertEqual(len(self.chat._chat_template_cache), 0)
+
+        # The Responses API sends text on multimodal models, decoded on demand.
+        processed = self.chat._process_messages(self.basic_req, is_multimodal=True)
+        self.assertEqual(self.chat._engine_prompt(processed, True), ("text", "Hi?"))
+
     def test_prompt_reuse_keeps_media_path(self):
         self.tm.model_config.is_multimodal = True
         self.chat.chat_encoding_spec = None
